items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: John Brune, that was after you.

ctx.x: Did Pichon ever play in the band with you then? Uh-huh.
Did Pichon ever play in John? No, no, no. John Brune, that was after you. John Brune, last letter from him and Dave. Him and Dave? Dave, you know Dave? Yeah, you know Dave?
